knowledge:
- key_parameters: X=Formula or matrix representing cell-level covariates (e.g., "~Batch" for batch effect removal) ;; K=Number of latent dimensions to estimate ;; verbose=Logical indicating whether to print progress (default FALSE, setting to TRUE can slow down computation on large datasets) ;; children=Number of cores to use for parallelization ;; n_gene_disp=Number of genes to use in the dispersion optimization (mini-batch) ;; n_cell_par=Number of cells to use in the cell-related parameters optimization (mini-batch) ;; n_gene_par=Number of genes to use in the gene-related parameters optimization (mini-batch) ;; commondispersion=Logical indicating whether to use a common dispersion parameter (default TRUE; if FALSE, estimates genewise dispersion)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: When performing dimensionality reduction and batch effect correction on raw, unnormalized single-cell RNA-seq count data
- pitfalls: Input data must be raw, unnormalized counts ;; The batch variable in colData must be explicitly converted to a factor for batch effect removal ;; Setting verbose = TRUE on large datasets can significantly slow down computation ;; Do not use n_gene_disp when commondispersion = FALSE as it will slow down the computation

workflows.name: scrna_dimensionality_reduction_batch_correction
workflows.intent: Perform dimensionality reduction and batch effect correction on raw scRNA-seq count data using NewWave, followed by latent space extraction.
input: data (a SingleCellExperiment object containing raw, unnormalized scRNA-seq counts and a batch covariate in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert the batch covariate to a factor ;; 2. Run newWave to perform dimensionality reduction and batch correction (using standard, parallelized, or mini-batch configurations) ;; 3. Extract the low-dimensional latent representation using reducedDim
workflows.code:
data$Batch <- as.factor(data$Batch)
res <- newWave(data,X = "~Batch", K=10, verbose = TRUE)
res2 <- newWave(data,X = "~Batch", K=10, verbose = TRUE, children=2)
res3 <- newWave(data,X = "~Batch", verbose = TRUE,K=10, children=2,
                n_gene_disp = 100, n_gene_par = 100, n_cell_par = 100)
res3 <- newWave(data,X = "~Batch", verbose = TRUE,K=10, children=2,
                n_gene_par = 100, n_cell_par = 100, commondispersion = FALSE)
latent <- reducedDim(res)
